verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B200 is GPU and data-center hardware. A sandbox or test environment kept separate from production data is a property of software services and APIs, not a GPU system, so this story is a category error for the product. The community posts about NVLink partitioning and VFIO isolation describe multi-tenant VM isolation built by third parties, not a vendor-shipped sandbox or test mode, so they do not make the axis applicable.
